message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Liu Moujia opened a clinic without a medical practice license, i.e., illegal medical practice. He was administratively punished twice, continued illegal practice, then turned himself in, withdrew illegal income of 20,000 yuan. The prosecution says his behavior violates criminal law and should be prosecuted. The relevant charge from the list is "非法行医". Indeed there is a label "非法行医". So the answer is that charge.

Check if any other charges apply: maybe "诈骗"? He earned illegal income but not necessarily fraud. The crime is illegal medical practice. So single charge: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>.

Thus final answer: "非法行医".
